Sure, it's the thirteenth of December, nineteen eighty-five.

Of course, it's one two three Maple Street, Rivertown.
Thank you for the information, Frances. We will process your claim and keep you updated. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all for now. Thank you.
You're welcome, Frances. Thank you for reaching out to Old Stone Auto Insurance. Have a great day!
